stem: Which imaging technique is considered necessary if a child's blood pressure is extremely high and requires three or more agents to control?
explanation: A formal angiogram may be required because standard renal Doppler ultrasounds can miss certain types of renal artery stenosis.
rationale: This procedure is the gold standard for identifying complex vascular issues like renal artery stenosis.

optionExplanations.A: A formal angiogram may be required because standard renal Doppler ultrasounds can miss certain types of renal artery stenosis.
optionExplanations.B: While a common first step, it is not definitive enough for severe, treatment-resistant cases due to its potential to miss stenosis.
optionExplanations.C: Chest X-rays are not used to diagnose the specific vascular causes of resistant hypertension described in the material.
optionExplanations.D: An echo is used to check for end-organ damage (LVH), but not for the primary vascular investigation of the renal arteries.

source.hint: This procedure is the gold standard for identifying complex vascular issues like renal artery stenosis.
